listings.name: HFS Trichology & Head Spa Inc.
listings.description: HFS Trichology & HeadSpa Inc. in Stockton was founded by Donielle Bolden, a certified trichologist with decades of experience in beauty and scalp wellness. Luxury head spa sessions and scalp care sit beside facials, protective styling consultations and wellness consultations that use ZYTO technology, listed as a ZYTO wellness scan. The spa is women-owned, offers memberships and online scheduling, and works by appointment. Rated 5.0 from 72 Google reviews, all of them five stars. Parking is free on site and on the street.

listings.name: Pure Holistic Skin Care
listings.description: Pure Holistic Skin Care in Placerville is an organic skin care studio with full body waxing, run by a certified bio resonance practitioner. The approach works from the inside out, with soothing protocols to balance the skin and body in a calm setting. Rated 4.9 from 33 Google reviews, 31 of them five stars and 2 at four stars. The studio is women-owned, takes appointments and has a free parking lot.

listings.name: NU Sugaring & Wellness
listings.description: NU Sugaring & Wellness in Yorba Linda pairs sugaring and waxing, eyebrow and lash tinting with wellness services including red light and NIR, Qest4 bioenergetics testing and foundation protocols. A 12-week health coaching package runs as a monthly one-hour Zoom call. Booking is online. Rated 5.0 from 29 Google reviews, all of them five stars. Appointments are required, and the entrance, parking and restroom are wheelchair accessible. Nostril and ear waxing and henna tint are also offered, opening hours and a cancellation policy are published are accepted.

listings.name: SKIN AND BEYOND
listings.description: Skin and Beyond in Fair Oaks is a woman-owned massage and skin care studio that welcomes LGBTQ clients. It offers massage in several styles, including pregnancy and sports massage, European facials, body contouring, hot stones, cupping, aromatherapy, Reiki and biofeedback and bioresonance sessions. Appointments are required. Rated 5.0 from 20 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: Mind, Body, and Sole Wellness
listings.description: Stacey, a registered nurse (RN), runs Mind, Body, and Sole Wellness in Citrus Heights, a calm, spa-like space owned by women. Her services include bioresonance body scanning, foot zoning, foot zone instruction, microcurrent therapy, foot bath spa sessions and friendship facilitation classes. She teaches as she works, so clients learn about each service as they go, and foot zone instruction teaches them the technique themselves. Rated 5.0 from 17 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: Illuminate Vitality
listings.description: Illuminate Vitality in Fresno offers Monicor Rofes biofeedback, a gentle, non-invasive wellness technology run by artificial intelligence that combines biofeedback, pattern recognition and meridian-based assessment to personalize each frequency session. Sessions come in one hour or 90 minute options, each personalized in a welcoming, holistic environment, and Reiki is delivered remotely. The business also operates as Soulful Animal Connections, led by Tatiana August, an intuitive animal communicator, with animal communication and animal soul blueprint sessions as well as Tetheva and energy work. A frequently asked questions section explains what to expect, testimonials can be submitted, and a blog and free gift go to those who join the circle. Rated 5.0 from 13 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: Gold Country Wellness
listings.description: Gold Country Wellness in Loomis is a bioenergetic practice working with QEST4 sessions and OligoScan mineral analysis, run by a practitioner certified in both. Sessions include a first visit and follow-ups, remote bio-resonance sessions that use a DNA sample, and sessions for pets. A three month rebalance package, hormone balancing sessions, emotional balancing with sleep support and weight consultations round out the offer. Clients can book online, join the members area, read the blog and use the shop. Educational support is part of every visit. Rated 5.0 from 10 Google reviews, every one of them five stars. Ask which sessions suit you before booking. The practice lists OligoScan mineral analysis as a separate session with an in-depth written report, and first visits and follow-ups are booked as separate sessions.

listings.name: Quantum Waves Hypnotherapy & Biofeedback
listings.description: Quantum Waves Hypnotherapy & Biofeedback in Los Osos is the practice of Gila Zak, C.Ht., a certified hypnotherapist, Certified Biofeedback Specialist and Silva Life System graduate. Sessions use a quantum biofeedback device, also known as the SCIO, to train the stress response, and hypnotherapy and certified advanced handwriting analysis are offered as well. Gila holds certifications from the American Hypnosis Association and professional memberships, and she works on the central coast of California, where she lives with her husband and animals. A new clients page, a FAQ, testimonials and media coverage give more background, and appointments can be booked online. Rated 5.0 from 10 Google reviews, every one of them five stars. A FAQ page covers common questions.

listings.name: Sol y Luna Wellness
listings.description: Sol y Luna Wellness in Kenwood is the practice of Dr. Sofia Swatt, PhD, a board-certified Doctor of Natural Medicine who trained at Quantum University in Hawaii. She combines biofeedback therapies with herbal medicine and personalised naturopathic protocols, with a focus on hormonal balance, skin health and metabolic support. Consultations, protocol reviews and ongoing check-ins can be completed remotely. The practice is Latinx-owned and women-owned, and appointments are recommended. Rated 5.0 from 10 Google reviews, every one of them five stars.

listings.name: Atrévete Al Cambio Integral Wellness Center
listings.description: Atrévete Al Cambio Integral Wellness Center in Santa Maria offers personal coaching sessions, workshops for personal development, leadership talks and fitness and nutrition advice in English and Spanish. A ZYTO scanner is part of the service list. Rated 5.0 from 9 Google reviews, all of them five stars. An appointment is recommended.

listings.name: Healtheee-U
listings.description: Healtheee-U is an herb shop in Carson that offers iridology readings with software and ZYTO balance scanning, along with consultations and herbal supplements and vitamins. Delivery and in-store pickup are available. Call to ask how a ZYTO session is booked and how long it takes. Rated 4.4 from 11 Google reviews, 7 of them five stars.

listings.name: Beyond Wholeness
listings.description: Beyond Wholeness in Encinitas is a woman-owned practice led by a facilitator and coach with 30 years of experience. She is certified in the Emotion Code, the Body Code, the Belief Code and Touch For Health kinesiology, has taught the Emotional Freedom Technique (tapping) and incorporates quantum biofeedback and guided meditation. Work areas include life transitions, income and abundance, relationships and couples and groups, and there are sessions for babies, children and animals. She has worked with hundreds of clients, including holistic practitioners, coaches, business owners and parents. A free consultation is offered, and the practice can be reached by phone on 760-525-4314 or by email. Appointments are recommended. Rated 5.0 from 7 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: Deenie Leon Inner Health Center Colon Hydrotherapy Treatment,Colonics Studio City,Calabasas,Topanga,West Hills
listings.description: Inner Health Center, led by Deenie Leon at 21201 Victory Blvd in Woodland Hills, is a one-stop wellness center with AO Scan technology and biofeedback sessions alongside lymphatic drainage, ear candling, a steam ozone sauna, an infrared sauna, hyperbaric oxygen, ionic foot baths and an EMS chair. Rated 5.0 from 7 Google reviews, all of them five stars. Appointments are required, and parking is free in a garage or lot. Phone +1 (818) 881-8400.

listings.name: Holistic Center For Natural Healing
listings.description: The Holistic Center For Natural Healing in Pleasant Hill offers in-depth consultations that cover physical, emotional, mental and spiritual wellbeing. A ZYTO biofeedback scan and a hair scan epigenetic mapping session are part of the menu, along with nutrition assessment, herbs, supplements, an ionic footbath, light therapy and energy balancing. Rated 5.0 from 6 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: Metamorphosis Health & Massage Therapy
listings.description: Metamorphosis Health & Massage Therapy in Redding, California is led by Shelley Giambastiani, CMP, who has twenty-five years of experience in therapeutic massage. Holistic consultations are guided by the ZYTO Body Scan, and her plan for each client uses recommended products and lifestyle choices. A Kangen ionic alkaline water machine with a three-stage filtration system was added recently, and gift certificates are available. Rated 5.0 from 6 Google reviews, all of them five stars. The business is women-owned and appointments are required.

listings.name: Quantum Biofeedback Inc.
listings.description: Nasrin Nehmadi, a Certified Quantum Biofeedback Specialist, leads Quantum Biofeedback Inc. in Beverly Hills. Sessions use an Eductor SCIO device and are tailored to each client's goals, with stress balance, energy balancing and skin rejuvenation among the topics, plus a sports programme. Clients can visit in person or take part remotely from anywhere in the world. Booking is online or by phone on 310-888-1177. Rated 4.6 from 7 Google reviews, 6 of them five stars. Further pages cover relaxation therapies, technologies, booking and contact details, and clients can leave a review or subscribe for updates. Clients come from Beverly Hills and from around the world, and a cell number, 310-897-4499, and an email address are listed. A skin rejuvenation page and a sports programme are also listed.

listings.name: SportsIQ
listings.description: SportsIQ in Westlake Village combines bioresonance with holistic nutrition, fitness and bodywork, founded by Brian Gulbranson and Erikka Dean-Gulbranson. Sessions use non-invasive, frequency-based technology with light, sound and PEMF, and a scanning system built for dogs, cats and horses means animals can be seen too. Youth programming introduces children to sports and confidence-building mindset training. Memberships, a recovery club and gift cards are available. Rated 5.0 from 5 Google reviews, all of them five stars. Free on-site parking. Opening hours are posted, the entrance, parking and restroom are wheelchair accessible, and cheque are accepted.

listings.name: Christel Clear
listings.description: Christel Clear in Hercules, in California's East Bay, is led by Lorilee Christel, a Certified Natural Health Practitioner and Certified Coach. Qest4 bioenergetic testing with meridian stress assessments is her main offer, alongside coaching, integrative bodywork, hypnotherapy and energy work. She is also an East Bay distributor for Young Living essential oils. Qest4 meridian stress assessments are now available, and the practice has recently moved to Hercules. DNA Vibe Jazz Bands are sold in the shop. Appointments can be scheduled online. Rated 5.0 from 3 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: Essentials 2 Wellness
listings.description: Essentials 2 Wellness in Kingsburg is led by a massage practitioner with 18 years in the field. Sessions combine bodywork such as Swedish massage, advanced reflexology, cranial sacral work, trigger point therapy and AromaTouch technique with ZYTO biofeedback and NES bio-energetics. Aromatherapy with doTERRA oils is used for deeper relaxation. Appointments are recommended. Rated 5.0 from 3 Google reviews, every one of them five stars.

listings.name: Juneva Health
listings.description: Juneva Health in Antioch offers bioenergetic sessions built around the NES body field scan and miHealth, with Energy For Life products and Infoceuticals. Other services include scalar wave sessions, BioScalar Infusion, PEMF, Rife and vibroacoustic therapy, and a Total Wellness Portal for clients, with a shop, news and learning resources. Bookings, a client login and a newsletter are available online, and learning pages explain Energy For Life, the successor to NES Health. Telehealth lets clients connect with practitioners from anywhere in the world, including remote body-field scans with the miHealth device. The practice works with people of all ages, welcomes LGBTQ clients and requires appointments. The entrance, parking and restroom are wheelchair accessible. Rated 5.0 from 3 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: Quantum Possibilities- SCIO Quantum Biofeedback
listings.description: Quantum Possibilities in San Diego is a women-owned wellness center built around SCIO Quantum Biofeedback, an EPFX/SCIO system described as technology based on quantum physics for stress-related areas of the body and mind. Sessions are suitable for adults, children and pets. Neurofeedback, nutrition guidance, chakra and meridian balancing, aura cleansing, NLP, and wellness and spiritual coaching broaden the range, with a focus on peak performance, brain function and learning. The practitioner works alongside her service dog, Sophie. Rated 5.0 from 3 Google reviews, all of them five stars. Biofeedback is described as a self-regulation mind-body process, and the practice explains how EPFX/SCIO works and what stress is. Contact and pricing details are available.

listings.name: Baird Chiropractic Center
listings.description: Baird Chiropractic Center is the Glendora practice of Lisbeth Baird, a Doctor of Chiropractic who serves San Dimas, La Verne, Azusa, Covina and the surrounding cities. Beyond spinal alignment, she offers QXCI SCIO quantum biofeedback sessions aimed at stress relief, NET emotional clearing, kinesiology, natural supplements and nutritional counseling. She takes a holistic approach to wellness and a supplement shop and a page on healthy pets sit alongside the practice. The office is at 528 East Route 66 and is open Tuesday and Friday from 10:00 to 1:00 and Wednesday from 10:00 to 5:00, with Monday, Thursday and Saturday by appointment only. Phone (626) 963-9463. Appointments are recommended, and the office has a wheelchair accessible entrance. Rated 5.0 from 1 Google review.

listings.name: Harmony Energy
listings.description: Harmony Energy in Visalia has been open since 2021 under Maureen Vaillette-Mancha, a board certified holistic health practitioner. Sessions include Qest4 bioresonance, custom supplement scans, Solex AO Scan and biofeedback, alongside Bio Charger NG, Rife, red light, PEMF, a Migun bed and a terahertz plate. Rated 5.0 from 1 Google review.

listings.name: Integrated Healing Medicine and Wellness
listings.description: Integrated Healing Medicine and Wellness in San Francisco is the practice of Dr. LeCompte, trained in both Western and Chinese medicine as well as homeopathy. Bioresonance, which uses vibrational frequencies, and the Asyra Pro bio-energetic testing system are part of a broad menu that also includes Plasma PERL-M technology, acupuncture, PRP and peptides. Rated 5.0 from 1 Google review. Appointments are recommended, so call to ask what a first visit involves.

listings.name: Functional Integrative Medicine
listings.description: Functional Integrative Medicine in Rocklin is an Oriental medicine clinic that offers AcuGraph meridian analysis, Metatron GR Hunter sessions, Rife frequency, ozone, reflexology and deep tissue work. Rated 1.0 from 1 Google review. Call to ask which sessions are available. Homeopathy resources and alternative options are listed too.

listings.name: Becoming Ancestors
listings.description: Becoming Ancestors in Sebastopol offers death doula services, with end of life support and planning, advance directives, home funeral guidance and green burial information. Josselyn also gives quantum biofeedback sessions, a practice she was introduced to twelve years ago and has been certified in since 2018. The programs include electro-acupuncture, chakra balancing and aura readings, and sessions are open to clients, their children and their pets. Pages cover how the sessions work, their benefits, services and rates. The entrance and parking are wheelchair accessible are accepted. Rates and packages for the end of life services are published, along with an explanation of what a death doula does and an inspiration page. Reach out through the practice to ask about availability and how to book.

listings.name: Beyond wellness and Beauty
listings.description: Beyond Wellness and Beauty in Glendora is a skincare and wellness space run by Josie Fares. The skin side offers custom facials, advanced peels and integrative skin services with advanced technology. The wellness side offers bioresonance scans and epigenetic hair analysis that feed into a personalized 90 day plan, along with frequency therapy, QHHT and Akashic sessions. Many of these, including the hair analysis, bioresonance scans and Akashic records readings, can be done remotely, and local clients can book in person.

listings.name: Body Electrick
listings.description: Body Electrick is a luxury mobile wellness studio in Van Nuys that brings its van to the client. Sessions include red light, PEMF, FlowPresso compression with infrared, microcurrent and NES Health scans. Corporate wellness and event packages are also offered. Call to ask where it travels and how to book.

listings.name: Body Energy Field
listings.description: Body Energy Field in Hayward works with NES Health, which brings research-led technology to bioenergetics. A wellness scan takes less than a minute, and the practitioner then recommends liquid products to support the body's energy field. Call to ask what a first scan involves and how to book.

listings.name: Christel Clear
listings.description: Christel Clear is the practice of Lorilee Christel, a certified natural health practitioner working in the East Bay near Berkeley. Bioenergetic testing and meridian stress assessments run on the computerised Qest4 system, alongside energy therapy, coaching, hypnotherapy and integrative bodywork. Lorilee is a California state certified massage therapist and a Young Living essential oils distributor. The Qest4 sessions are described as now in Hercules, so confirm the address by phone. Appointments can be made online.

listings.name: Healing ways Quantum biofeedback
listings.description: Healing ways Quantum biofeedback in Riverside offers quantum biofeedback sessions and Ampcoil sessions, alongside colon hydrotherapy and Hydrafacial MD skin sessions. Call to ask which biofeedback system is used and what a first visit involves.

listings.name: Holistic Metaphysical Healing
listings.description: Holistic Metaphysical Healing in Agoura Hills was founded in 2023 by wellness facilitator Regan Luithly. The center offers quantum biofeedback along with Alphabiotics, the Demartini Method, Bowenwork, Emotion Code, Body Code, PSYCH-K, CranioSacral Therapy, SomatoEmotional Release, Holy Fire Karuna Reiki and AmpCoil, aimed at stress management and wellbeing. Call to ask how to book.

listings.name: Hydrate Wellness dba Lumati Life
listings.description: Lumati Life, formerly Hydrate Wellness, is an alternative wellness practice in Encinitas. Its on-site services include NLS Longevity Bioresonance scans, hydrogen and oxygen immersions, a PBM Recharge Portal, Rasha Dome sessions, acupuncture and nutritional counseling. It also sells supplements and wellness devices for use at home. No Google reviews have been posted yet.

listings.name: Mindful Living and Wellness Corp.
listings.description: Mindful Living and Wellness Corp. in Costa Mesa combines F-Scan biofeedback, Firefly light therapy and customized nutrition plans. The F-Scan is a Swiss-engineered biofeedback technology that maps how the body responds to thousands of frequencies, and Firefly light therapy combines red, blue, green and near-infrared light. The practice also distributes the technology, selling Firefly units and MitaCell products. The practitioner aims to empower clients toward wellbeing using the F-Scan and Firefly. Appointments are arranged by email or by phone on 714-488-2129.

listings.name: Quest Biofeedback Health Services
listings.description: Quest Biofeedback Health Services is a quantum biofeedback practice led by Dr. Sherine Legge, with more than fifteen years in practice. Sessions are offered in the office and remotely, and the team uses biofeedback devices that train the body's own feedback responses. Supplements can be ordered through the practice, client testimonials are published, and appointments can be booked online. It is based in Southern California and is described as located in Mission Viejo, though it is listed under San Juan Capistrano, so confirm the address and service area by phone before visiting. A team of trained specialists runs the sessions. Booking is through the appointments page.

listings.name: Ruthy's Oroville Holistic/SCIO Biofeedback
listings.description: Ruthy's Oroville Holistic/SCIO Biofeedback in Oroville is the practice of Ruthy, a SCIO biofeedback administrator known for a calm manner. Sessions are by appointment. Call ahead to ask how a first SCIO session works, how long it lasts and how to book. Call ahead to ask about remote sessions.

listings.name: The Wellness Scan Co at OC
listings.description: The Wellness Scan Co at OC offers non-invasive holistic wellness scans using biofeedback technology, located inside Plunge Performance & Recovery in Dana Point. Scans cover multiple body systems, and each session includes a personalized report and wellness insights meant to support informed lifestyle choices. The focus is on clarity and whole-body balance.

listings.name: Zarabi Quantum Biofeedback
listings.description: Dr Parviz Zarabi runs Zarabi Quantum Biofeedback in Beverly Hills. He has used biofeedback with clients for the past 17 years and is certified by the Natural Therapies Certification Board, with training from the British Institute of Homeopathy. Pages cover his services, technology, a video library and testimonials, and a contact form is open for anyone who wants to arrange a consultation. A page about Dr Zarabi sets out his background, and the services page lists a variety of biofeedback services.

listings.name: Holistic Healing Work
listings.description: Holistic Healing Work in Roseville is a hypnotherapy and holistic wellness practice. Its offerings include Reiki, breathwork, biofeedback training, heart rate coherence training, Emotional Freedom Technique, Thought Field Therapy and NLP, along with dream work, inner child work, past life regression and grief and end of life support. Handwriting analysis, intuitive numerology and psychic mediumship round out the list. Rated 5.0 from 25 Google reviews, all of them five stars. The business is women-owned and welcoming to all. Sessions take place on site.

listings.name: BENEFITS OF QUANTUM BIOFEEDBACK AND QUANTUM REFLEX ANALYSIS
listings.description: In Los Banos, an alternative medicine practice trades under a name that spells out its two focus areas: quantum biofeedback and quantum reflex analysis. It is a local option for anyone in the area who is curious about either approach. Call ahead to ask which biofeedback system is used, what a first session involves and how appointments are booked.

listings.name: Nelian Nutrition Counseling & Bio-Resonance Scanning
listings.description: Nelian Nutrition Counseling & Bio-Resonance Scanning is a wellness center in Burbank that puts nutrition counseling and bio-resonance scanning in its name. For anyone nearby curious about either, it is a local option to contact directly. Call ahead to ask which device is used, what a first appointment involves and how to book.

listings.name: Parkside Health & Wellness Center Dr. Joseph Bogart
listings.description: Parkside Health & Wellness Center in Parkland is a team of chiropractors, massage therapists and acupuncturists offering chiropractic adjustments, massage, Class IV laser, shockwave therapy, acupuncture and Asyra technology. Corrective exercises, orthotics and nutritional counseling are also offered. Appointments are required. Phone (954) 340-7545. Rated 4.9 from 290 Google reviews, 284 of them five stars.

listings.name: Banner Harvest CBD
listings.description: Banner Harvest CBD in Leesburg, Florida, is a family-owned CBD and wellness shop serving The Villages and Central Florida, run by co-founders Paul and Yolanda. It makes its own CBD oils in-house and sells gummies, drinks, topicals, pet products, vitamins and supplements, with an apothecary section and help choosing products. Walk-ins are welcome for shopping and guidance. By appointment it also offers AO Scan wellness sessions, which combine a ten-second Inner Voice analysis with a Vitals scan through bone-conduction headphones, followed by a one-to-one conversation with a team member, as well as Theraphi sessions. Rated 5.0 from 107 Google reviews, 105 of them five stars. The team also publishes a journal, an interactive learning centre and a guide that helps visitors pick a product by starting point, such as sleep, stress, daily wellness or pet wellness.

listings.name: Colonics 4 You
listings.description: Colonics 4 You in Hollywood is a wellness center built around colon hydrotherapy, ion foot baths and quantum bio-resonance and biofeedback sessions. Biomagnetism and castor oil packs are on the service list as well. It is a holistic center for alternative therapies. Single sessions can be booked on their own. The center welcomes LGBTQ clients, has a wheelchair accessible entrance and takes card and mobile payments. Rated 4.9 from 79 Google reviews, 76 of them five stars.

listings.name: Vida Fit By Juliane Almeida
listings.description: Tech-driven training is the idea behind Vida Fit in Orlando, a fitness center led by Juliane Almeida. It offers EMS training and a treadmill programme, personalised nutrition and training plans through an app, 3D body composition scans, bioresonance and food-based supplements. Rated 5.0 from 72 Google reviews, every one of them five stars. Call to ask how a bioresonance session fits with a training plan.

listings.name: Ideal Wellness Center
listings.description: Ideal Wellness Center in Juno Beach is a recovery and wellness studio run by appointment. ZYTO scan sessions sit alongside PEMF therapy and Firefly light therapy, with RMR and VO2 max metabolic assessments and personalised wellness plans to give clients a clearer picture of how they move and recover. Rated 4.9 from 77 Google reviews, 76 of them five stars.

listings.name: Keep Young Wellness
listings.description: Keep Young Wellness in Lady Lake pairs massage and manual lymphatic drainage with AO Scan sessions, craniosacral therapy and emotional release work in a Theta Chamber. The practitioner holds certifications in AO Scan evaluation and frequency scanning, craniosacral therapy and scar therapy. Veteran owned, with appointments required. Rated 4.9 from 67 Google reviews, 64 of them five stars.

listings.name: Clermont Wellness Center
listings.description: Formerly Clermont Herb Shoppe & Day Spa, Clermont Wellness Center has served central Florida for over 25 years with the same staff. Private wellness consultations and ZYTO scans are available for anyone who wants a personalised program, and ZYTO Balance Compass scans help clients choose products. The center stocks vitamins and aromatherapy and sells CellCore, Pure Encapsulations and Nature's Sunshine, and its spa lists facials, HydraFacials, FLOWpresso and Bemer sessions. Gift certificates, a blog and resources are posted. Phone 352-243-3588. Rated 4.6 from 81 Google reviews, 66 of them five stars. The center describes its mission as educating health-conscious Central Floridians with quality products and therapies. Gift certificates can be bought for friends and family.

listings.name: Holistic Haven Nutrition
listings.description: Holistic Haven Nutrition in Sarasota combines one-on-one wellness consultations with the Qest4 biofeedback scan, using it to shape personalised nutrition and lifestyle suggestions. The shop carries more than 1500 supplements. Rated 4.9 from 60 Google reviews, 59 of them five stars. Call to ask how a scan and consultation are booked.

listings.name: Bio Harmony
listings.description: Near the Brightline Aventura station, Bio Harmony is a certified bioresonance center serving Miami, Aventura, Fort Lauderdale, Sunny Isles and Hollywood. Sessions use Regumed technology, with a full-body scan and bioresonance sessions on offer, plus nutrition and supplements. Visit options include an introductory visit, a full assessment session and regular sessions, and a free online consultation can be booked. Appointments are booked online or by phone on 1 (786) 550 8850. Rated 5.0 from 52 Google reviews, every one of them five stars. Support areas include sleep, stress, energy and emotional balance, a bioresonance therapy page and a nutrition and supplements page explain each service, and client testimonials are posted. Located one minute on foot from the station, the center has direct rail access from Miami, Fort Lauderdale, Boca Raton and West Palm Beach.

listings.name: The Medical Healing Center
listings.description: The Medical Healing Center in Tallahassee is an adult primary care practice with an emphasis on holistic care for mind, body and spirit. Angela Myers, APRN, is among the team. Services include EPFX/SCIO (QXCI) sessions with energetic balancing, homeopathy, integrative services, hyperbaric oxygen, ozone, IV nutrition and aesthetics. Rated 4.3 from 48 Google reviews, 38 of them five stars and 8 at one star. Appointments are required, and the entrance and parking are wheelchair accessible. Call (850) 309-1665.

listings.name: Firefly Within
listings.description: Firefly Within is a biofeedback practice in Bonita Springs where the practitioner works with quantum biofeedback, Reiki and essential oils. Her approach is aimed at balance in body, mind and spirit, and she describes building a community around that. The business is owned by women and posts its opening hours. Rated 5.0 from 17 Google reviews, every one of them five stars.

listings.name: Accurate Wellness Thermography
listings.description: Accurate Wellness Thermography in Jupiter is built around thermography imaging, and it adds bioresonance sessions, iridology and assisted lymphatic drainage massage. Functional lab work and herbal guidance are part of the range, and the practice explains insurance codes for its thermography scanning protocols. Its stated aim is helping clients understand their individual needs and put an individualised wellbeing plan in place. Appointments are required. Rated 4.8 from 18 Google reviews, 17 of them five stars and one at one star.

listings.name: SYNC Longevity Lab
listings.description: A Clermont longevity lab, SYNC combines AI-powered 3D body scanning and VO2 metabolic analysis with skin, body and brain programmes. The list includes microneedling with exosomes, EMS neo body sculpting, red light sessions, brain photobiomodulation and Brain Flow biofeedback for stress resilience, backed by weekly coaching on nutrition and movement. Consultations can be booked online or by phone on (321) 441-4447. Rated 5.0 from 11 Google reviews, all of them five stars. Weight, memory and sleep programmes are listed alongside.

listings.name: Clermont Injury and Rehab
listings.description: Dr Judy Husbands, a chiropractor with over twenty years of experience, leads Clermont Injury and Rehab. Chiropractic adjusting techniques and spinal decompression are on offer, and the practice also provides ZYTO Balance scanning. Rated 4.8 from 10 Google reviews, 8 of them five stars. Call to ask how a ZYTO scan fits with a visit.

listings.name: Quantum Healing Discoveries
listings.description: Quantum Healing Discoveries in Delray Beach is run by a certified practitioner of quantum hypnosis (QHHT, Level 2) who also works with Emotional Freedom Technique, Emotion Code and Body Code, quantum manifestation coaching and Kundalini yoga. Her AO Scan work comes in series of sessions, from a starter series to a longer wellness series, alongside a quantum iris scan and a private nutrition consultation. Hypnosis sessions run for three or five hours. Hypnosis follows Dolores Cannon's methods, and heart-brain coherence practices are part of the offer. Hypnosis and yoga plans are available, along with a course. The practice serves local and remote clients worldwide. Rated 5.0 from 8 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: Biodynflow Wellness Studio
listings.description: BiodynFlow is a wellness studio in Hallandale Beach serving Aventura, Hollywood and Sunny Isles. It offers Reiki, sound sessions with crystal bowls, bioresonance and biofeedback sessions, body-oriented therapy, Access Bars, yoga, pilates, breathwork and meditation. Its proprietary biodynamic method combines energy practices, conscious movement and restorative bodywork. Individual sessions, wellness consultations, an academy and multi-day Reset Retreats are available, and the studio can be reached on +1 (305) 427 1013. Rated 5.0 from 7 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: Dr. Amadi's Wholistic Health Center
listings.description: Dr. Amadi's Wholistic Health Center in Coral Springs is led by Dr. Hepsharat Amadi, who combines conventional and holistic approaches. Quantum biofeedback sessions use the EPFX and SCIO biofeedback systems, and the center also offers footbaths, BrainTap, BEMER sessions, nutrition and lifestyle counseling, and herbal and homeopathic support. Sessions are personalized, required forms are completed before a first visit, opening hours are posted, and appointments are recommended. Call (954) 757-0064. Rated 4.9 from 28 Google reviews, 25 of them five stars.

listings.name: Scio Healthy Living

It also sells herbal and organic products such as shilajit and pure honey. Rated 4.9 from 30 Google reviews, 29 of them five stars and one at one star.

listings.name: World of Wellness
listings.description: World of Wellness in Saxmundham, Suffolk, is a women-owned beauty and wellness centre led by Inna, a bioresonance practitioner who works with DeVita bioresonance technology. One-to-one consultations take place in Suffolk, and a worldwide consultancy service is offered too. Beauty lounge sessions, frequency and light facials and hot stone massage sit alongside a shop selling DeVita devices and wellness products. Rated 5.0 from 24 Google reviews, all of them five stars. On-site parking is available.

listings.name: Sports, Bowen & Bioresonance Therapy
listings.description: Sports, Bowen & Bioresonance Therapy is a practice run by Amber Lewis in St Albans, Hertfordshire, covering St Albans and Hemel Hempstead. It offers sports massage, sports therapy, the Bowen Technique, Bowen hormonal work and bioresonance therapy, and its pages share testimonials from athletes and fitness professionals. Amber became interested in bioresonance therapy in 2023 after her daughter had sessions, and she now recommends it alongside her massage work. Rated 5.0 from 23 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: BioresonanceUK
listings.description: BioresonanceUK is a bioresonance clinic on Canvey Island, Essex, led by Wendy Coles, who trained in Spain, the Netherlands and Germany and has spent six years seeing clients in clinic. Sessions are available in person, as home visits or remotely, and the clinic runs training for professionals on using their bioresonance machines, with sessions in British Sign Language on offer. It also sells bioresonance devices for home use and EMF protection products. The business is owned by women. Rated 5.0 from 12 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: Lumiair
listings.description: Lumiair, in Norwich, works by appointment only and specialises in vibrational sessions: multi-sensory sound journeys, bioresonance scans, frequency workshops and retreats. It also makes a range of 12 bioenergetic scents for homes, wellness venues, hospitality spaces, offices and retail units. Rated 5.0 from 12 Google reviews, every one of them five stars.

listings.name: Inna health
listings.description: Inna Health in Leigh-on-Sea, Essex, is a bioresonance clinic built around a Bicom bioresonance device. Energetic scanning sessions can be done in clinic with sensor headphones or remotely, using a sample sent by post. Activated oxygen therapy and forest air sit alongside the scans, with nutrition and wellness guidance and a pre-booking form for new clients. The clinic also runs a shop with affiliate products and offers free downloads on air, light, water and nutrition topics, and its team page introduces the therapists. Appointments are recommended. Rated 5.0 from 11 Google reviews, every one of them five stars. Its pricing page lists the sessions on offer, and a clinic page sets out packages for new clients. Ask which scanning option suits you before booking.

listings.name: Albany Health
listings.description: Albany Health provides integrated natural health care in Woodbridge, Suffolk, for all ages from newborns to the elderly. Its team of practitioners offers osteopathy, podiatry, MBST, one to one Reformer Pilates, massage, physiotherapy, counselling and psychotherapy, nutritional therapy, homeopathy and bioresonance, herbal medicine and acupuncture, and each therapy can be booked on its own. The practice has a hearing loop, free street and on-site parking, and takes card and mobile payments. Appointments are required and the number to call is 01394 382866. Rated 5.0 from 10 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: Homeopath Essex Coral is a holistic health coach using homeopathy and bio resonance
listings.description: Coral Byford combines homeopathy, bio-resonance and diet and nutrition support in Brentwood, Essex. She works with the Qest 4 machine and, since moving her practice online, can scan from a hair sample and provide detailed reports for remote clients. Personalised 3 or 6 month programmes include scans, online consultations and nutrition support, alongside a hormone wellness package and family options. New clients can book a free 15 minute consultation, and a shop and blog are available. Rated 5.0 from 7 Google reviews, all of them five stars. She is also a qualified diet and nutrition adviser, and her approach brings together homeopathy, bio-resonance and nutrition. Separate pages cover each service, and family options are available. Monthly payment options are offered for programmes.

listings.name: Daisy Wellness
listings.description: Daisy Wellness in Ware, near London, is a calm sanctuary run by Margareta that brings together Reiki, quantum entrainment, FOHOW massage, bio-resonance, the Emotion Code, hypnotherapy and Soul Medicine. Sessions are shaped around the person rather than a set programme, and events are held at the sanctuary. Rated 5.0 from 3 Google reviews, all of them five stars. The business is women-owned. Sessions are booked online. A philosophy page and an events page are published.

listings.name: Bioenergetic and Quantum Health Screening
listings.description: Bioenergetic and Quantum Health Screening in Kings Langley offers bioenergetic screening sessions and bioresonance therapy, along with neuroanadrasis. Its Greek-language page presents it as a homeopathy and bioresonance centre and quotes Nikola Tesla on energy, frequency and vibration. Confirm the address and service area by phone before you visit.

listings.name: Mind & Body Detox
listings.description: Mind & Body Detox in Dunmow is a nutrition and fitness business that offers bioresonance sessions alongside one-to-one personal training, a ladies-only semi-private training group and online programmes. It works mostly with busy women and offers a free strategy call to new clients. Appointments are recommended. Rated 5.0 from 1 Google review, at five stars.

listings.name: Aaron Allergy Centre
listings.description: Aaron Allergy Centre in Basildon, Essex, offers bioresonance sessions using Rayocomp bioresonance therapy combined with E-Lybra homeopathic balancing and acupoint meridian therapy, which uses no needles. Pets can be included, with a sample of fur brought to the clinic in a sealed bag. This combination is named Environmental Resonance Therapy, or E.R.T. The centre also publishes articles by bioenergetic practitioner Leigh Bradley on the beginnings of bioresonance, research into energetic therapies, electromagnetic fields, Wi-Fi, dirty electricity and geopathic stress. Clients come from across Essex, and the centre runs as a clinic with posted hours. Call to ask about a first appointment and how to book.

listings.name: Bioresonance Natural Therapy
listings.description: At 79 Bramford Lane in Ipswich, Bioresonance Natural Therapy uses the BICOM Optima system for non-invasive bioresonance sessions and holistic wellness consultations. The approach supports overall wellbeing and balance and helps clients make informed lifestyle choices in a friendly, comfortable setting. Call to ask what a first session involves and how to book.

listings.name: Body Reset Hertfordshire
listings.description: Body Reset Hertfordshire in Hoddesdon is a women-owned practice that uses bio-resonance scans as the starting point for its sessions. Trained bio-resonance therapists use the full-body scan reports to offer therapies and lifestyle advice, with a focus on stress management and sleep quality. The scanning device can also be used on a home clinic basis by the whole family. Opening hours are posted, and the practice welcomes everyone, with wheelchair accessible parking, seating and a unisex restroom. Phone 07815 767077 to arrange a first session.

listings.name: Cedar Lodge Wellness Centre
listings.description: Hypnotherapy, NLP, CBT and Pilates for wellbeing are on the list at Cedar Lodge Wellness Centre in Ipswich, a wellness centre offering a range of modalities for mental and physical wellbeing. Bio resonance and homeopathy are offered with its expert practitioners. Call to ask which practitioner offers bioresonance, what a first session involves and how to book.

listings.name: Holistic Quantum Health Center
listings.description: Quantum biofeedback, auriculotherapy and homeopathy are the three services listed by Holistic Quantum Health Center in Norwich. Call to ask which system is used, what a first quantum biofeedback session involves, what hours the centre keeps and how appointments are booked. It is a local option for anyone in Norwich curious about quantum biofeedback.

listings.name: Radiant Health Hub
listings.description: Radiant Health Hub in Radlett offers bio-resonance sessions alongside homeopathy, vibrational essences and other natural modalities. The practitioner holds a degree in homeopathy, has studied natural essences and brings more than 30 years of experience in health care. Call to ask about the device used and how a first session works.

listings.name: Very Healthy - Health Coach, Nutrition Support, Bioresonance, Eczema, Allergies
listings.description: Very Healthy in St Albans offers personalised nutritional health coaching and bioresonance sessions with Michaela, who works with adults and children. Consultations include practical nutrition and lifestyle guidance shaped around each person, and bioresonance is described as a gentle, non-invasive approach. The practice has pages for pricing and packages, a blog, an FAQ and a consultation request form. Clients from St Albans, Flitwick and Spain share their experiences, and the practice takes a caring, holistic approach. Packages can be requested along with a consultation.

listings.name: Mizan Bioresonance
listings.description: Mizan Bioresonance in Norwich runs under a name that points to bioresonance sessions. Call to ask which device is used, what a first session involves, what hours it keeps and how appointments are booked before you plan a visit. It is a local option for anyone in the city curious about a session.

listings.name: Japanese Acupuncture - Bioresonance & Supportive Therapies
listings.description: Michail runs this London practice, which pairs Japanese acupuncture and Chinese medicine with device-based bioresonance. An initial assessment looks at pulse, tongue, abdomen and meridians. Bioresonance sessions use Asyra Pro, NLS Hunter and Deta Elis Professional for a detailed look at organs and systems. Remote sessions are possible with a DNA sample, a voice recording and a recent photograph. Other options include Tuina massage, SCENAR, low level laser, molecular hydrogen, ozone, a Spooky2 Rife machine and a Bio-Mat, plus healthy living guidance and retreats. A free 15 minute consultation is offered. Appointments are required. Rated 4.9 from 44 Google reviews, 43 of them five stars. Client testimonials are shared, and a page on other services covers detoxification protocols and healthy living guidance for everyday routines.

listings.name: Bioresonance Therapy London / Biofeedback / Holistic Healing
listings.description: Based in W5 Ealing, this practice combines bioresonance, biofeedback and natural approaches with elements of life coaching. Sessions are tailored to the whole person, covering body, mind and energy, with a focus on stress reduction and energy balance. The list includes bioresonance scans, zapping, meta sessions and frequency work. A follow-up session runs one hour, a full body scan two hours and a first session with the full range three hours. Appointments are required. Rated 5.0 from 30 Google reviews, 29 of them five stars.

listings.name: Bioresonance4you - London
listings.description: Claire Granahan founded Bioresonance4you after a career of about 40 years in the corporate world, having begun with Reiki more than two decades ago. A first consultation includes a Bicom body scan, after which the client is connected to a Bicom Optima for further sessions. Frequencies from a session can be stored on a Bicom chip to take away. The practice works with Regumed technology and favours a preventive approach to wellbeing. New clients receive pre-session preparation guidance and can book online, and a book on bioresonance is available. The practice offers on-site services. Rated 5.0 from 17 Google reviews, all of them five stars. A short video explains bioresonance, and headings cover the holistic approach, non-invasive sessions and detox support.

listings.name: Bicom London
listings.description: Working on the latest generation of Bicom Optima device, Bicom London has offered Bicom bioresonance in the city for over 25 years. Body scan check sessions are on the menu, and the practice also covers stress among its areas of interest. New clients can read an overview of bioresonance before booking. Appointments are recommended are accepted. Rated 4.5 from 23 Google reviews, 20 of them five stars and 3 one star. Call ahead to ask how a first session works and how long it lasts.

listings.name: Bicom Allergy and Intolerance Testing Instant Results - Longevity - Detox - Lyme
listings.description: Bioresonance sessions on a Bicom device are offered at this London practice, which gives its experience as more than 40 years. The Bicom company was founded in Germany 35 years ago. Sessions come with elimination diet advice and an introduction to herbal supplements. New clients can book a complimentary call with the nutrition team to talk through which option suits their situation, or request a call back or an appointment online. Booking runs through the practice's own online shop, and a testimonials section shares client experiences. Appointments are required are accepted. Rated 5.0 from 15 Google reviews, every one of them five stars. Clinics are in London, and a Bicom step by step page walks clients through what happens during a session.

listings.name: Healing Worldwide
listings.description: Body scan sessions with bioresonance and radionics are offered from Avenue Mansions in London NW3, alongside a six week health optimisation programme, books and recommended products. A free 15 minute phone consultation is available to anyone who wants to talk through what to expect before booking. Reviews describe a first body scan as professional, with suggestions given afterwards. Appointments are required. Rated 4.6 from 9 Google reviews, 8 of them five stars and one at one star. Phone 07780 880676.

listings.name: The Holistic Hub London
listings.description: Founded by Sharmila Hume, The Holistic Hub takes a bioregulatory approach to wellbeing from its London base, with bioresonance sessions, nutritional supplements, BRMT and Weleda products. Programmes include BioPerformance and Brain Health, with a recovery room on site, and lifestyle support runs alongside. Clients complete a history form, then talk through their background before sessions begin. Both in-person and online sessions are available, and people travel from across the UK and abroad. Appointments are recommended. Rated 5.0 from 5 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: Prime Integrative Health
listings.description: Prime Integrative Health in Romford, London combines bioresonance with naturopathic principles, with every plan personal to the client. Three paths are available: a Bioresonance Wellness Screening, a Naturopathic Consultation, and an Integrative Health Assessment that joins both in one extended session. Longer sessions begin with a conversation about the client's history, lifestyle and goals. Advanced laboratory tests are also offered. Practitioner Nicolae leads the practice. Rated 5.0 from 3 Google reviews, all of them five stars. Appointments are booked online.

listings.name: Bioresonance and Detoxification
listings.description: Metatron sessions sit at the centre of this London practice, which works with a non-linear bioresonance system. Bioinductors are placed on the head and the full scan runs for about 30 minutes, with results shown in real time on 3D software. A health questionnaire and optional iris analysis come before it, and the scan can be paired with detox support. Online private consultations on nutrition and herbal protocols are available, and remote scanning is offered too. The practitioner lists skills and qualifications for clients to read, and further pages cover VR Metatron, pyramid devices and client feedback. Everything is written in English and Bulgarian. Rated 3.5 from 2 Google reviews. A disclaimer and privacy policy are published, the contact page includes a form, and one page covers the quantum entanglement idea behind remote scanning.

listings.name: Anican UK
listings.description: Face-to-face bioresonance sessions are the focus at Anican UK, a London wellness centre. Each session is personalised, and a curated range of wellbeing products and services is also available online. Call to ask which device is used, what a first session involves and how to book before you travel.

listings.name: biohealth
listings.description: Asyra Pro bio-resonance scan sessions are the work of this Newington Green practice in London N1, with Canonbury overground the nearest station. The practitioner has been certified in Asyra since 2012 and first worked from a pharmacy in the Barbican before relocating. A five minute scan with the Asyra Pro forms the starting point for a longer consultation, and new clients can book a consultation to begin.

listings.name: Helixa Therapies
listings.description: Women-owned Helixa Therapies in London brings bioresonance together with homeopathy, Bach flowers, EFT and breathing techniques. Health and nutrition coaching is part of the mix, so a visit can combine a bioresonance session with lifestyle guidance. Call to ask which therapies suit your goals and how long a first appointment takes. Opening hours are posted, an about page introduces the practitioner, and each therapy has its own page explaining what a session involves.

listings.name: Lloyd Gee - Naturopath & Herbalist
listings.description: Lloyd Gee offers naturopathy and herbalism consultations in London, with Asyra bioenergetic sessions as part of the mix. His work combines detailed lifestyle guidance with tailored herbal formulations drawn from Western and Chinese traditions, aimed at vitality and resilience. Consultations take place in person or online.

listings.name: Natural Approaches
listings.description: Natural Approaches is a naturopathic clinic in Swanley that blends Western functional approaches with Traditional Chinese Medicine, Ayurveda, constitutional analysis, bioresonance and biomagnetism. Its NLS device, the Hunter Meta 4025, uses a headset to listen to the body's subtle electromagnetic activity, and Biomagnetic Pair Therapy and Remote Bioenergetics Therapy are also offered. Most services can be delivered remotely, although pulse reading is available only in person, and consultations are offered in person and virtually to clients in the UK and internationally. Care plans come as a Wellness Foundation or a Premium Health Optimisation path, and the team adds habit formation coaching, lifestyle optimisation and concierge-level management. A discovery call is the place to start, a team page introduces the practitioners.

listings.name: Newlands Park Natural Healthcare Centre
listings.description: Several therapists share Newlands Park Natural Healthcare Centre in London, among them a bioresonance practitioner, a homeopath, a kinesiologist and a counsellor, with sports and remedial massage also on offer. Kinesiology and counselling are available in the same building. Call to ask which practitioner suits you and how bioresonance sessions are booked.

listings.name: Pure Homeopathy
listings.description: Pure Homeopathy in Swanley, Kent, is a homeopathy practice that also offers bioresonance health screening. It is a local option for anyone in Swanley interested in a bioresonance session. Call to ask what a first appointment involves, which device is used, where appointments take place and how to book.

listings.name: Roblaw Natural Health
listings.description: For physical, mental, emotional and spiritual wellbeing, Roblaw Natural Health in London offers bio resonance scanning with detox support, massage therapy, and nutrition and exercise plans. A selection of natural products is also sold. Call to ask how a first visit works and what a session involves.

listings.name: Lilias Ahmeira
listings.description: After thirty years in practice, Lilias Ahmeira is a London holistic practitioner who lists bioresonance, EFT, A.R.T. and electronic gem therapy among the fields she introduced to the UK. She was also an accredited magnet therapist. Rated 5.0 from 93 Google reviews, 92 of them five stars. Call to ask which sessions are currently offered and how to book.

listings.name: Acupuncture and Bioresonance Centre
listings.description: Acupuncture and Bioresonance Centre is an acupuncture clinic in Croydon that puts bioresonance in its name. The clinic welcomes LGBTQ clients and is a transgender-safe space, and appointments are required. Rated 5.0 from 3 Google reviews, all at five stars. Call or email ahead to ask which devices are used and how to book.

listings.name: Dr Stephen Simpson MB ChB MFOM MBA
listings.description: Dr Stephen Simpson works from London as a mind coach and hypnotherapist and describes bioresonance among his skills. He is also a presenter, TEDx speaker and author, with books, audiobooks and podcasts alongside his performance coaching for high-profile clients. Rated 5.0 from one Google review. Call to ask whether bioresonance sessions are part of what he currently offers.

listings.name: Bioresonance Plus
listings.description: Bioresonance Plus is a nutritionist practice in London where qualified nutritional therapists work closely with each client on a personalised plan. Alternative therapy services are offered, with availability around the clock and opening hours posted. Call to ask whether bioresonance sessions are part of what is on offer and how to book.

listings.name: Quantum Biofeedback by Augusta
listings.description: Augusta works as a biofeedback practitioner in London, and her practice name points to quantum biofeedback. It is a local option for anyone in the city who wants to try a biofeedback session. Call to ask which biofeedback system is used, what a first session involves and how appointments are booked.

listings.name: Pure Vibes by Christina
listings.description: Pure Vibes by Christina is a wellness practice in Beeton built around AO Scan bioresonance technology by Solex. Sessions combine biofeedback scans with AI wellness tools and personalised programmes, from a first frequency scan to the Longevity Blueprint Program and the Inner Frequency Method. The practice also covers energy and sleep routines, emotional balance, PEMF and light therapy, water ionisation and purification, supplements and home wellness tools. The business is owned by women. Rated 5.0 from 41 Google reviews, every one of them five stars.

listings.name: Harmonic Egg Ottawa
listings.description: Harmonic Egg Ottawa is a women-owned wellness centre where sessions take place in a bio resonance chamber that combines sacred geometry, sound, colour and light. Clients can book an in-person session or a remote session from home, which follows the same steps by phone or Zoom, and remote sessions can be done for a pet or for a space. Land and space clearing is also offered, and the team publishes a podcast, a blog and testimonials. Pricing, packages and booking policies are posted. Rated 5.0 from 39 Google reviews, every one of them five stars.

listings.name: Quantum & Holistic Wellness Clinic Reverse Aging Wellness Clinic
listings.description: Quantum & Holistic Wellness Clinic, also known as Reverse Aging Wellness Clinic, is a women owned clinic in Mississauga that pairs modern wellness technology with older traditions. Services include quantum biofeedback, an Electro Interstitial Scan, introspective hypnosis, QHHT, PEMF and scalar therapies, red light therapy and colon hydrotherapy. It also offers slimming wraps, Venus Freeze, holistic aesthetics, Raindrop Technique, Tibetan massage, reflexology and a Lectro Chi negative ion session. Appointments are required and free parking is on site. Rated 5.0 from 34 Google reviews, 33 of them five stars.

listings.name: Karen Jay-Moore Soul Path Psychotherapy & Holistic Services
listings.description: Karen Jay-Moore Soul Path Psychotherapy & Holistic Services in Orillia is led by Karen Jay-Moore, M.Ed., a Registered Psychotherapist who works with children, teens, adults, couples and families in person in Barrie and Orillia and online. Holistic services include AO Scan biofeedback, Reiki, evidential mediumship and psychic readings and spiritual guidance, and she teaches Reiki training, workshops and intuitive development. Karen is also an author whose book won the International Impact Book Award. A complimentary consultation can be booked, and appointments are required. Rated 5.0 from 30 Google reviews, every one of them five stars. Her pages also introduce Dianne, a second practitioner, and an articles and insights section, with resources for learning and growth. Sessions can be booked as a first appointment or as a follow-up,, and her books and resources are published for readers.

listings.name: Studio on 88/ QFHealing
listings.description: Known as the Hairapist for over 45 years, the owner of Studio on 88/ QFHealing in Bond Head combines hair cutting with energy work. The services list includes quantum biofeedback, a homeopathy practice, crystal work, therapeutic touch, Ancient Egyptian Reiki and spiritual advice. Hair cuts with energy work are chair service only, and a full session is booked as a separate appointment. Visits are by appointment, arranged by text. Rated 5.0 from 29 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: Community Health & Prevention Care - Mental Health Counselling Scarborough
listings.description: Community Health & Prevention Care serves Scarborough in Toronto with quantum biofeedback, neurofeedback, PEMF, InLight, BrainTap and HeartMath Emwave Pro sessions. Counselling, chiropractic, physiotherapy, preventive care education, a weight management programme, a 30 day meal plan and an anti-inflammatory eating guide round out the offering. Virtual services are listed too. Phone (416) 439-2001. Rated 5.0 from 22 Google reviews, every one of them five stars. Phone numbers include 1 (844) 947-0292 for international callers and (416) 729-1064, and Facebook and Instagram profiles are linked.

listings.name: Energy Over Matter - Bio Resonance Scan, Hypnotherapy, Sound Healing, NLP, PEMF
listings.description: Energy Over Matter in Newmarket offers bio scan sessions that use NES miHealth technology and Infoceuticals, in person or remotely, along with PEMF, hypnotherapy, NLP, bioenergetic wellness coaching, yoga sound baths, meditation and online courses. New clients can book a free discovery call, and a free community circle and free account give access to audio and video tools. The practice also hosts a podcast, publishes books and a blog and runs a shop with chakra pendants and audio experiences. Bookings are made online, and appointments are recommended. Rated 5.0 from 19 Google reviews, every one of them five stars. Its pages also cover a Bio Scan service page, yoga sound baths, meditation, books and a podcast, and the business has won a Centre of Excellence 2025 Inspiration Award.

listings.name: NIM Centre, Natural and Integrative Medicine
listings.description: Reni leads NIM Centre, Natural and Integrative Medicine, which uses quantum biofeedback with each client. Sessions are paired with health coaching and Dolphin Neurostim microcurrent point stimulation. New clients can book a free consultation or an appointment online. Reni also keeps a blog on natural integrative medicine, and client comments praise her knowledge of quantum biofeedback. Rated 5.0 from 10 Google reviews, all of them five stars. A page explains what quantum biofeedback is and how it is used, and visitors can read comments from clients, browse the blog and write to reneta.pereira@gmail.com. The centre works with clients of all ages and invites them to take the first step towards a new routine for stress and energy balance. Appointments are booked online.

listings.name: NUTRAPURE HEALTH MANAGEMENT CENTRE
listings.description: NutraPure Health Management Centre in Richmond Hill offers precision nutrition, personalized wellness programs and ZYTO Balance assessments. Its services include InBody 380 body composition analysis, nutrition consultations, sleep and stress support, women's wellness, longevity programs and a 100 Families Health Together Program. Online sessions are available and work much like in-person ones, with simple instructions to join. The team can be reached by phone, and sessions are booked online. Rated 5.0 from 10 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: The Holistic Haven Collective
listings.description: The Holistic Haven Collective in Sarnia, Ontario, is a women owned wellness space where several practitioners share one address. Services include ZYTO scans, massage therapy, art therapy, Reiki, 9D breathwork, breath and sound therapy, tarot and psychic readings, and an on-site apothecary shop with herbal products and natural goods. Events such as a Full Moon Tea Party are on the calendar, and practitioners can apply to join the collective. Appointments are recommended and the entrance is wheelchair accessible. Rated 5.0 from 7 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: Dr. Julie Chan - Markham Naturopathic Doctor and Acupuncturist at Liberty Wellness Clinic
listings.description: Dr. Julie Chan practises at Liberty Wellness Clinic in downtown Markham as a board certified naturopathic doctor, registered acupuncturist and NES practitioner, with almost 20 years of experience. She works with clients of all ages. Her services include acupuncture and cupping, plant-based nutrition, pediatric care, homeopathy, herbal medicine, lifestyle guidance and nutritional counseling, and she runs a naturopathic insomnia program and a program for ADHD care. Bioenergetic and biofeedback sessions use NES Health, Energy4Life and Genius Biofeedback, and the aim is to harmonize the energies of the body to support wellness. Virtual appointments are offered across Ontario, with in-person visits in the Greater Toronto Area. Appointments are required and free parking is on site. Rated 4.9 from 7 Google reviews, 6 of them five stars.

listings.name: Universal Touch Holistic Health
listings.description: Universal Touch Holistic Health in Sarnia offers ZYTO biocommunication scans, followed by suggestions that can include herbs, oils, supplements and vitamins. Crystal therapies, spiritual counseling and spiritual energy readings with tarot or oracle cards are on the list as well. The practice is owned by women and welcomes LGBTQ clients. Appointments are required. Rated 5.0 from 6 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: Ecohealth & Wellness
listings.description: Krop BioResonance Studio is a division of Ecohealth & Wellness in Mississauga, built on more than 40 years of experience in holistic health. The studio uses Bicom bioresonance exclusively for its sessions, a technology from Germany. A first visit can include a computerized organ scan, a Bicom bioresonance balancing session, a chakra screening on the Asyra and a discussion of the client's concerns and goals. The team is led by Jozef Krop (MD retired, CNP), and a video series, articles and events explain how bioresonance is used. Appointments are recommended, and the entrance and parking are wheelchair accessible. Cards are accepted. Subscribers receive articles and event news. Rated 4.8 from 6 Google reviews, 5 of them five stars.

listings.name: Bio-Care Bioresonance Therapy
listings.description: Bio-Care Bioresonance Therapy in Thornhill, Ontario is led by a certified biofeedback and bioresonance therapist who is also a holistic nutritionist. Sessions place electrodes on the skin and connect to a Bicom machine, and SCIO biofeedback and Oligoscan are also on the menu, along with a Bicom body check and aromatherapy. Remote sessions and a vet wellness service for animals are offered. A shop and a visit page are available. Rated 5.0 from 5 Google reviews, all of them five stars. Call 1-416-316-1061 to ask about booking. A Bicom body check gives new clients a quick start. The therapist is certified in biofeedback and bioresonance and is also a holistic nutritionist, and bioresonancecanada@gmail.com handles enquiries.

listings.name: Bioresonance Therapy
listings.description: Bioresonance Therapy has served East Gwillimbury and nearby Sharon, Ontario, since 2013. The practitioner holds Regumed certification as a bioresonance therapist and is a registered holistic nutritionist trained at the Canadian School of Natural Nutrition. A first consultation uses an NLS non-linear scanning device, a biofeedback tool, and later sessions use BICOM bioresonance, which is tailored to each client. Follow-up sessions last 60 minutes and run in person or remotely, and a remote therapy option suits clients who live far away. Nutrition support is offered too, and each follow-up adjusts the programme to the client's response. Contact is by phone, text or email on 416-605-8523. Rated 5.0 from 4 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: Bio Supreme Canada
listings.description: Bio Supreme Canada is a Richmond Hill health spa that works with the Regumed BICOM device, including the BICOM Optima, and has more than 10 years of experience. Bioresonance sessions are offered for people and for animals, and the practice also supplies BICOM devices, accessories and special equipment, with a library and a section on principles for anyone who wants to learn more. Appointments are recommended, and parking and the restroom are wheelchair accessible. Rated 5.0 from 3 Google reviews, all of them five stars. Call or email for details. The BICOM Optima is billed as the bioresonance therapy of the future, and the practice's pages also cover the product range, CTT accessories and a library of reference material.

listings.name: Elevated Wellness
listings.description: Elevated Wellness at 1087 Vindin St in Midland, Ontario, offers AO bio-resonance scan sessions, including an Inner-Voice scan, and frequencies can be sent to pets as well. The range also includes focused shockwave therapy, Wolfe non-surgical deep tissue therapy, regenerative cellular therapy, Bioptron light therapy and personalised health coaching. Articles, press coverage and a price list are published, the clinic welcomes enquiries by phone, and bookings can be made on 07957 341 741. Rated 5.0 from 31 Google reviews, all of them five stars.
