Organic products, medicinal teas and homeopathy are on offer. Appointments are recommended. Rated 5.0 from 15 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: Advanced Skin Care
listings.description: Advanced Skin Care in Casper, Wyoming, is a boutique with more than 30 years of experience in skin care and holistic wellness. Alongside laser sessions, crystal-free microdermabrasion, microcurrent facials and a body wrap, it offers a 30-minute ZYTO Handscan Balance to help clients choose a personal blend of dōTERRA essential oils. A certified holistic coach is on the team, and the shop carries Colorescience, Sanitas and Clarisonic products. Booking is online. Rated 5.0 from 6 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: Hope Healing Haven
listings.description: Hope Healing Haven is a biofeedback practice in Powell, a sanctuary for overall wellbeing. The service list includes AO Scan sessions, neurofeedback, mindset coaching, a Soqi bed with a Chi machine, an ionic foot bath and Raindrop sessions. Rated 5.0 from 6 Google reviews, all of them five stars. Call for current opening times.

listings.name: Black Hills Wellness, LLC
listings.description: Black Hills Wellness in Sundance is a holistic practice offering health consultations, massage, ionic foot sessions and ZYTO scans, with massage therapy also offered. Call to ask what a first ZYTO session involves. A restroom is on site.

listings.name: Dr. Jared C. Pistoia, ND
listings.description: Dr. Jared C. Pistoia, ND, is a naturopathic physician and author in Farmington, Connecticut. He combines natural medicines, counseling and ZYTO scans, with expertise in homeopathy, nutrition, herbal medicine, supplements, biofeedback and spirituality, and he welcomes LGBTQ clients. Appointments are required. Rated 5.0 from 23 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: Shift Wellness
listings.description: Shift Wellness in Wallingford, Connecticut is a women-owned studio run by Joanna, a holistic practitioner, and serves nearby Meriden, New Haven, North Haven and Hamden. Services include occupational therapy, massage in Swedish, deep tissue and sports styles, cupping, IASTM, IonCleanse, a PEMF mat, an infrared sauna mat and the ZYTO wellness scan, with nutrition consultations in person or online. Rated 5.0 from 9 Google reviews, all of them five stars. Resources and wellness journeys are published, a restroom is on site are accepted.

listings.name: Inner Wisdom Healing, LLC
listings.description: Inner Wisdom Healing, LLC in Lisbon has served clients since 2009 under Heather Rose, a National Board Certified Health and Wellness Coach. Qest4 bio-energetic analysis sits alongside intuitive tarot and oracle readings, life and wellness coaching, and Emotion Code and Body Code sessions. Rated 4.3 from 6 Google reviews, five of them at five stars and one at one star.

listings.name: Quantum Essence Integrative Healing, LLC
listings.description: Quantum Essence Integrative Healing, LLC in Manchester is led by Dr. Brian Ruggiero, D.C., a bioenergetic practitioner and hypnotherapist. Qest4 bioenergetic scans are the core service, done with handheld electrodes or with a hair sample for virtual scanning, and imprint tinctures can be made from the scan. The practice also offers hypnosis, Emotion Code sessions, Reconnective and shamanic energy work and ionizing foot baths. Sessions are booked online, and returning clients can sign in to manage their bookings. Natural Nutmeg articles and a link to the Ruggiero Family Chiro & Rehab Ctr. are published. Phone 860-960-3460. Appointments are recommended. Rated 5.0 from 3 Google reviews, every one of them five stars. The practice describes bridging ancient wisdom and modern bioenergetic technology, and it welcomes first-time visitors who feel traditional approaches have fallen short.

listings.name: Rightway Health and Wellness
listings.description: Rightway Health and Wellness in Woodstock is a women owned wellness center that offers ZYTO biofeedback sessions, Evox perception reframing, assisted lymphatic therapy and red light therapy. It also runs local wellness education and mentoring. Rated 4.6 from 20 Google reviews, 18 of them five stars. The entrance and parking are wheelchair accessible.

listings.name: Advanced Medical and Chiropractic
listings.description: Chiropractic, naturopathic and homeopathic services share one Atlanta address at Advanced Medical and Chiropractic, with Dr Mike Greenberg and Dr Kurt Miller as chiropractors and Dr Nadya Dhanani offering classical homeopathy. A ZYTO wellness scan uses a hand cradle for about 20 minutes. Shockwave therapy and a weight management programme are listed, and insurance information is posted. Phone (470) 799-2384. Rated 5.0 from 14 Google reviews, all of them five stars. An about page, a gallery and a contact page are posted, and product ranges include Orthomolecular and Energetix.

listings.name: Tuscan Sun Massage and Wellness
listings.description: Tuscan Sun Massage and Wellness serves Atlanta, Decatur and Tucker, Georgia, with massage therapy, lymphatic drainage massage and ZYTO scans, which it describes as bioenergetic work. The team takes a whole-person approach that looks at diet, nutrition, exercise and lifestyle habits, and uses Energetix natural products. Rated 4.9 from 8 Google reviews, 7 of them five stars.

listings.name: Just Look In My Eyes Wellness
listings.description: Dr Roxanne Padmore, ND, leads Just Look In My Eyes Wellness in Atlanta, where iridology and iris analysis come together with a ZYTO body scan and the Visera Link scan, which is done in person from signals read from the hands. Phone sessions are available from anywhere for those who want to explore nutrition and stress. The practice also offers detox and cleanse programmes, gemstone accessories and a range of products, with pages on iridology for women, an FAQ and wellness reels. Phone 470-496-7272. Featured products include Power Greens, Power Beets and Power Balance, and pages cover reviews, an FAQ and what iridology is. A second phone line, 470-795-0850, is listed, and the practice speaks to wellness for every woman at every stage.

listings.name: My Vital Force - Holistic Health Hub
listings.description: My Vital Force Holistic Health Hub & Wellness Center in DeWitt, Iowa, is owned by veterans and women. It offers health coaching, naturopathic consultations, stress management biofeedback sessions, bioenergetic wellness scans, ZYTO scans and Evox perception reframing sessions, along with the Raindrop Technique, Rife frequency sessions and ionic foot baths. Clients who cannot visit can book virtual, phone or long distance appointments, and online scheduling is open. Weight loss wellness classes run at the center, and stress relief techniques are taught. Vitamins, herbs, essential oils and other natural products are available. Hours vary, so call to fit a visit around your schedule. Visits are by appointment, and client forms and a blog are provided. Rated 5.0 from 7 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: Bluebird Bridge Holistic Wellness LLC
listings.description: Bluebird Bridge Holistic Wellness in Sioux City offers QEST4 bioenergetic testing and balancing, together with health coaching that focuses on the foundations of wellbeing. Card payments are accepted, and bookings go through the practice by phone on 712-899-9440 or by email. Phone to ask about opening times and how a session runs. The parking is wheelchair accessible.

listings.name: Ground Zero Vitality
listings.description: Ground Zero Vitality is a health consultancy in Clive that offers AO Scan sessions alongside Emotion Code and Body Code work. Call to ask what a first session involves, how long it lasts and how to book.

listings.name: Resonant Health Collective
listings.description: Resonant Health Collective in Grimes offers remote bioenergetic wellness scans for adults, children, pets, homes and businesses, all using Qest4 bioresonance technology. Scans are performed remotely from a DNA sample submitted by the client, and animal scans are done the same way. Each scan comes with a personalized wellness report and individualized recommendations delivered through a secure client portal, and bioresonance products are sold in the shop. One-time scans and membership plans are available, with home, business and bundle options. New clients can start with an introduction for those new to bioresonance, and can sign up, purchase a subscription or start a scan online. A shop and FAQ are provided. Appointments are recommended.

listings.name: Your Healing Place
listings.description: Your Healing Place in Baltimore is a Black owned and women owned wellness practice led by Dr. Stephanie E. Reid, a naturopath and author with more than 20 years of experience in naturopathy, coaching and homeopathy. It focuses on women over 40 and uses ZYTO Link technology and the ZYTO hand cradle scan, and clients can choose a Skype or phone session with Dr. Reid. Her From Panic to Empowerment book series supports the coaching, and personalised wellness strategies are built from each scan. Her clients look for clarity, vitality and purpose, and hair tissue mineral analysis is also part of her toolkit. Rated 4.9 from 40 Google reviews, 37 of them five stars. Call to confirm hours and how to book.

listings.name: Bioenergetic Health & Wellness Center
listings.description: Bioenergetic Health & Wellness Center in Westminster, Maryland offers an NES Health Bioscan together with StemWave, red light laser, PEMF, the EESystem and ionic foot baths. The practitioner holds NES Bioenergetics health coach certification and board certification from the American Association of Drugless Practitioners. Rentals and research pages are published. Rated 5.0 from 2 Google reviews, both of them five stars. The entrance, parking, restroom and seating are wheelchair accessible. Opening hours are posted, cheque, card and phone payments are accepted, and there is on-site parking and a hearing loop. Testimonials and FAQs are published.

listings.name: Integrative Family Consulting
listings.description: Integrative Family Consulting in Ocean City offers ZYTO Elite biocommunication scans along with health and wellness coaching for families and individuals, essential oil protocols, Symphony of the Cells, sound bowl sessions and Reiki. Call ahead to ask how a scan session works, how long it lasts and how to book.

listings.name: Massage, Sound & Wellness
listings.description: Massage, Sound & Wellness is the Bishopville, Maryland, practice of Jen Esch, LMT, at 13201 Hatchery Rd. Services include ZYTO wellness scans, Reiki, massage therapy, sound bowl sessions and essential oil therapy, with a baseline ZYTO scan for new clients and mobile massage for elderly clients. A massage, Reiki, sound bowl and Symphony of the Cells medley can be combined in one session. The practice is owned by women, parking is wheelchair accessible. Call 410-271-2835 to book.

listings.name: Healing Waters
listings.description: Colon hydrotherapy is the best known service at Healing Waters, a wellness center at 2660 S Rainbow Blvd in Las Vegas, which also offers the Oberon scan, a virtual biofeedback scan. The list continues with a zapper, plasma generator, far infrared sauna, ionic foot baths and ear candling, with packages and pricing posted and a booking page. The team page introduces the practitioners, and the centre shares food guidance, wellbeing tips and interviews. Rated 4.9 from 67 Google reviews, 64 of them five stars and 2 four stars.

listings.name: Holistic Essentials
listings.description: Colon hydrotherapy by an I-ACT certified specialist is one of many services at Holistic Essentials in Las Vegas. A ZYTO biocommunication scan sits beside Reiki, doTERRA essential oils, energetix products, quantum balance and Juice Plus+. Skin care, spray tanning and teeth whitening are also offered, including mobile spray tanning. Rated 5.0 from 11 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: Las Vegas Body Wellness LLc.
listings.description: Oberon scan and zapper sessions are the focus of Las Vegas Body Wellness, whose practitioner opened her first practice in 2000 in the Czech Republic. Magnetic therapy and oxygen colon hydrotherapy have been added to the range. The business lists services at 2660 S Rainbow Blvd in Las Vegas, including colon hydrotherapy, a plasma generator, far infrared sauna, ionic foot baths and ear candling, with a booking page and health tips for clients. Rated 5.0 from one Google review. Call to confirm hours.

listings.name: Enlightenment Wellness Center
listings.description: Enlightenment Wellness Center in Las Vegas offers bioresonance sessions with a MORA device, described as an electromagnetic biofeedback machine. The center lists wellness center and biofeedback therapist among its categories. It is rated 1.0 from one Google review. Call to ask what a session involves, how long it lasts and how to book.

listings.name: Norris Healthcare
listings.description: Norris Healthcare is a family owned holistic practice with more than 45 years of history, serving Camas and Vancouver, Washington. Services include chiropractic care, SpectraVision biofeedback scanning, ZYTO scanning, laser therapy, biomagnetism therapy, neuro-emotional clearing, nutritional therapy, an ionic foot bath and supplements with frequency imprints. Remote appointments are available for clients who live too far away or are out of state. Appointments are required, and the entrance, parking, restroom and seating are wheelchair accessible. Rated 5.0 from 27 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: Vital Body Wellness
listings.description: Vital Body Wellness is a wellness program in Republic that combines quantum biofeedback with emotional energy balancing and mind-body-spirit integration. Personalised protocols and educational support aim to help clients reconnect with their energy and vitality. Rated 5.0 from 5 Google reviews, all of them five stars. Call to ask how a first session works.

listings.name: Valued Wellness
listings.description: Valued Wellness in Centralia offers Solex AO Scanning, which graphs the vibrational frequencies of the body, followed by vibrational attunement. Other services are Joy Coaching, relaxation sessions, grief coaching, holistic health coaching, First Aid and CPR classes and dōTERRA essential oils. Call or text 360-880-2558 for appointments. Rated 5.0 from 2 Google reviews, both at five stars.

listings.name: REJUVENANCE THERAPY
listings.description: Rejuvenance Therapy is a holistic, integrative practice in Vancouver led by Dr. Sarah Dible, a Doctor of Physical Therapy and functional medicine practitioner who focuses on care for women. Services include physical therapy, craniosacral therapy, NAET, BioSet, whole food nutrition and bioresonance quantum medicine, with a dispensary of recommended products. In person and virtual care are available, and street and on-site parking are free. Dr. Dible shares a blog and wellness resources, and appointments are recommended. Rated 5.0 from 1 Google review.

listings.name: Body Balance Idaho
listings.description: Body Balance Idaho in Meridian is run by Bonnie, who offers MONICOR sessions, a gentle bioresonance wellness scan with personalised frequency support, and Emotion and Body Code sessions. Virtual Body Code sessions are available for people who prefer to stay home. Clients are invited to contact Bonnie first and find the right starting point, and a page explains how the two services differ. Pricing, FAQ and testimonials pages are published. Rated 5.0 from 16 Google reviews, every one of them five stars.

listings.name: Lotus Studio
listings.description: Lotus Studio is a boutique wellness studio in Rexburg with classes in meditation, sound bath, breathwork and yoga, plus nutrition counseling. Biofeedback scans on ZYTO and Biowell are offered, together with Lumiceuticals frequency and light sessions, Reiki, Facezoning, lymphatic movement and halo harmonics light. The studio sells Joy Organics CBD products, and its classroom and therapy room can be rented by teachers and practitioners. Rated 5.0 from 10 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: Integrative Wellness Center
listings.description: Integrative Wellness Center in Hayden brings together practitioners in biofeedback, PEMF, massage, holistic chiropractic, reflexology, nutrition response, Emotion Code and homeopathy. Its biofeedback sessions use the SCIO system, described as assessing nearly 11,000 parameters, and a PEMF device is also in use. Practitioners such as Anna Strong are profiled. Clients can browse a practitioner directory, join a biofeedback waitlist and schedule appointments, and the center offers holistic wellness for families. Call (208) 772-6015.

listings.name: CH Biohealth, Health & Balance
listings.description: CH BioHealth in Volksrust, Mpumalanga is a wellness lounge run by Charlene Heyneke. A bio resonance scan and a two-minute Quantum Analysis Scan are available, together with a sauna pod, lymphatic drainage and pressotherapy, an ionic foot session, a massage chair and TENS and EMS muscle sessions. Everything starts with a conversation on WhatsApp, with no fixed programme. Rated 5.0 from 8 Google reviews, all of them five stars. Phone 084 810 9504. Free Wi-Fi is available. Health products are on sale are accepted.

listings.name: Kamala Wellness Centre
listings.description: Kamala Wellness Centre in Middelburg is a women-owned health and beauty shop offering biofeedback sessions with a quantum resonance magnetic analyzer, which it describes as a stress system. Appointments are required. Rated 5.0 from 8 Google reviews, every one of them five stars. Call ahead to ask what a session involves and how to book.

listings.name: Quanta Health
listings.description: Quanta Health in Mbombela is a health consultant offering holistic frequency sessions built around bio-resonance technology. Call ahead to ask which device is used, what a first session involves, how long it lasts and how to book. Ask which scanning option suits you and how to book.

listings.name: Body Basics Healing Center
listings.description: Body Basics Healing Center in Española works from biofeedback information, using a ZYTO Compass scan to recommend supplements from the Nature's Sunshine herbal and vitamin line. The practice also refers to pH balancing in its guidance. Rated 5.0 from 4 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: Restore Wellness and Beauty LLC
listings.description: Restore Wellness and Beauty in Santa Fe is a skincare and wellness studio run by a licensed esthetician who is also a nutritional therapy practitioner. Facials include Hydrafacial, custom, oxygen and microcurrent options, with nano-needling and gentle peels. The wellness side covers PEMF sessions and bio-resonance. Rated 5.0 from 1 Google review. Booking is online.

listings.name: BioResonance-Biofeedback and Relaxation
listings.description: BioResonance-Biofeedback and Relaxation is a biofeedback practice in Roswell, listed under wellness center as well. It is rated 5.0 from 2 Google reviews, both at five stars. Call to ask what a session involves, which device is used and how to book.

listings.name: Rejuven8 Holistic Health, Pain Relief and Detox Centre
listings.description: Rejuven8 Holistic Health, Pain Relief and Detox Centre in Rustenburg offers 4D quantum biofeedback SCIO scans alongside Rife frequency sessions, an ozone pod and low level laser photobiomodulation. Rated 5.0 from 28 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: Herbzbar Wellness
listings.description: Herbzbar Wellness in Mahikeng is a women-owned naturopathic practice licensed to work with herbs. It uses bioresonance machines for scans and offers colon therapy, ozone therapy and Rife sessions. It has one Google review, rated five stars. Call ahead to ask what a first session involves and how to book.

listings.name: ReikiWorx
listings.description: ReikiWorx Pilates & Rehab Centre offers Pilates classes, both monthly group classes and individual, Reiki sessions, pelvic chair therapy and Scio biofeedback therapy. Scio sessions run between an hour and a half and two hours, and the centre also offers a Reiki ceremony for couples. The parking, seating and restroom are wheelchair accessible, cards are accepted and appointments are recommended. Call 082 326 4720 to confirm the location and how to book.

listings.name: All About Stress Release & More
listings.description: All About Stress Release & More is a fitness and wellness practice in Regina. The practitioner is a certified Tension and Trauma Release (TRE) provider, a certified quantum biofeedback specialist, a certified iridologist and a certified NLP practitioner, with training in applied kinesiology and nutritional counselling. TRE, nutritional counselling, applied kinesiology and quantum biofeedback are all available in person or online. Rated 4.8 from 10 Google reviews, 8 of them five stars. The business is women-owned and has free parking.

listings.name: Angel Spiritual Connections Wellness Center
listings.description: Angel Spiritual Connections Wellness Center in Fort Qu'Appelle is owned by Maureen Bandas and offers gentle, non-invasive services for emotional, mental, physical and spiritual wellbeing. Her offerings include Reiki, chakra balancing, Access Bars, Shiva Murti Balinese energy work and hypnotherapy for stress and confidence. AO Scan frequency-based services include Inner-Voice and Whole-Body scans using voice-based frequency analysis, and signature remote wellness programs. Remote space and land clearings and Reiki certified training classes are offered as well. The center is a safe and loving space that uses frequency and energy modalities, and a free guided meditation and Maureen's story are offered. A free parking lot is on site. Rated 5.0 from 3 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: Dream Wellness
listings.description: Dream Wellness in Lloydminster is a wellness centre offering SCIO biofeedback sessions. The shop side stocks handmade malas, bracelets, crystal car charms and macrame creations. Call ahead to ask how a SCIO session works, how long it lasts, where appointments take place and how to book. Ask whether remote sessions are possible too.

listings.name: Cultivate Wellness
listings.description: Cultivate Wellness in Taylors is an appointment-only wellness center that pairs massage therapy and manual lymphatic drainage with quantum biofeedback and PEMF sessions. Biofeedback wellness coaching and functional nutrition are on the service list, and wellness gift cards are sold. Rated 5.0 from 15 Google reviews, all of them five stars. Booking is online, by phone on (864) 924-9477 or by WhatsApp, and the entrance and parking are wheelchair accessible. A restroom is on site are accepted.

listings.name: Harmony and Fusion LLC
listings.description: Harmony and Fusion LLC is a wellness center in Greenville offering BrainTap brain entrainment sessions, bioresonance biological information sessions, PEMF, Qigong and energy work. Computer SEG (electro-segment-electrography) is also on the list, along with supplement assessments and energetic supplement preparation. A comprehensive evaluation and weekly session options are available. It is a small wellness center that pairs technology-based sessions with movement practices such as Qigong. Rated 5.0 from 4 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: Stout Wellness
listings.description: Stout Wellness in Greer offers ZYTO scans and bio sessions, along with an individualized supplement program, wellness counseling, food counseling, sauna time, exercise readiness and wellness seminars. It is open by appointment only, with online booking, and seminars are run for the community. Call to ask which sessions are currently offered. Rated 5.0 from 1 Google review, at five stars.

listings.name: Flower of Life Biofeedback
listings.description: Flower of Life Biofeedback is the practice of Melanie A. Crawford, a Certified Holistic Health Counselor (HHC), offering QuEx-ED quantum biofeedback sessions aimed at emotional wellbeing and athletic ability. The practice is at 250 Main Street, Suite 102, Room D, in Montpelier, Vermont, and Barre is the listed city. Parking is wheelchair accessible. The business is categorised as a biofeedback therapist. Rated 5.0 from 1 Google review. Email the practice or call to confirm hours and how to book.

listings.name: Cutting Edge Salon Artistic Styles
listings.description: Cutting Edge Salon at Artistic Styles, 269 North Main in Rutland, Vermont, is run by Michelle, who has more than 32 years of experience in precision haircuts, custom colour, skin care and waxing. Alongside the salon work she offers Reiki sessions and, as a ZYTO specialist, personalised wellness sessions with ZYTO scans aimed at balance and stress. Call 802.236.0669 to book.

listings.name: Judy Breitmeyer--Greater Wellness Consultant
listings.description: Judy Breitmeyer is a wellness coach and Young Living Brand Partner in Greensboro Bend. She uses survey tools, including the ZYTO Scan, which gathers responses from the body to help work out wellness options, so clients can make healthier choices based on how their body responds.

listings.name: E. Dando Holistics
listings.description: E. Dando Holistics is a natural health practice in Newport, South East Wales, run by Emma Dando. Bioresonance sessions can take place face to face at one of several clinic locations across South East Wales, or remotely using a small hair or fingernail sample. Other services include kinesiology, naturopathic nutrition, Reiki, tuning fork sound therapy, acupuncture, Seichem, flower essence therapy, well-being retreats, talks and workshops. Gift vouchers are available and appointments are required. Rated 5.0 from 24 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: Newton Hale Centre of Bioresonance (NHC)
listings.description: The Newton Hale Centre of Bioresonance (NHC) is a therapy centre run on the north-west border of England and Wales. Its pages explain the client journey, bioresonance and life coaching through Peace2gether, and a team stays in touch by phone on 01244 911 999. Reviews and news are published, and clients can register online. Rated 5.0 from 10 Google reviews, all of them five stars. The entrance, parking and restroom are wheelchair accessible, and an appointment is recommended. The centre calls itself modern, supportive and quick-developing, with a skilled team whose work is regularly reviewed.

listings.name: Wellness for all
listings.description: Wellness for All in Abergele is a holistic practice that uses dowsing and a bioresonance machine in its sessions. It also runs in-person courses that teach dowsing for personal health and wellness. Call to ask what a first session involves and how to book.
